title: 输入流水线与双路输出
scope: unit_fake: real SQLite/UpperStore + real UpperOutputRouter; B03 models, B01 settings/catalog and both senders are substitutes. Real Host event wiring belongs to B10/B11.

environment.host_version: AstrBot 4.26.7 present at D:/Code/AstrBot-latest (read-only, not on PYTHONPATH)

changed_files.note: appended UpperOutputRouter and upper_* source constants; PublicOutputRouter untouched

interfaces.UpperPipeline.process(trusted, *, public: returns handled, suppress_default, error_code, plan_id (+ route, control_status, public_sent, duplicate, control_error, public_error)
interfaces.argmax_route(probabilities) -> route: framework-side decision; C01 tie order speech_only > speech_and_action > action_only
interfaces.UpperOutputRouter.permits_public_output(: True only for upper_public without a plan_id
interfaces.UpperOutputRouter.permits_automatic_outp: Host output-hook gate; False for every upper_* source and for any plan_id
interfaces.UpperOutputRouter.claim(*, source, plan_: raises source_not_public / invalid_source instead of silently dropping
interfaces.UpperOutputRouter.emit_public(plan_id, s: claim -> record sending -> await sender(text) -> record sent/delivery_unknown
interfaces.result_factory: injectable so B10 can pass B00's UpperProcessResult; default returns a mapping with the four contracted keys

dependencies.need: TrustedUpperInput fields (trusted, sender, platform, origin, source_message_id, robot_id, user_id, session_id, input_text, route_ref) and UpperResult fields
dependencies.state: absent; consumed through the documented field surface

dependencies.need: PromptAssembler.build(settings, catalog) with prompt_hash / catalog_version / settings_hash
UpperModels.classify(input_text, prompt_snapshot, provider_id) -> three probabilities; generate(input_text, route, prompt_snapshot, provider_id) -> UpperResult without route
capabilities(peer) and inject(peer, batch) -> outcome with status/error_code

entry_points: None yet. B10 must call process() from the real event hook, pass a public_sender bound to that event, and use permits_automatic_output() to suppress the Host default reply.

python -B -m unittest discover -s astrbot_plugin_astrbotex_interaction/tests -p test_upper_output_isolation.py -v -> 12 tests OK

known_issues: public_text semantics are not enforced: a hostile model can still phrase a claim of success. C04 §2 accepts this; only field routing is guaranteed.
TrustedUpperInput requires a non-None sender/event object. B00 must include that field or B10 must pass a wrapper; this is the anti-forgery signal.
input_busy still delivers the already generated public text; the control batch is not reserved at all, so no segment can be sent later for that plan.
emit_public reads two private UpperStore helpers (_reply_row/_reply_projection); both modules ship together so the coupling is contained.
consumers_to_retest: B08 (no direct dependency, but shares error codes)
rollback: Stop constructing UpperPipeline; the legacy PublicOutputRouter keeps its original behaviour and the upper_* tables stay.
